scope: Databento historical CME Henry Hub NG provider evaluation against preserved Massive evidence

databento_public_capability.catalog_coverage_caveat: Per-schema and per-account availability can differ; account-specific range is not inferred from catalog coverage.
databento_public_capability.historical_pricing_model: usage_based_or_flat_rate; metadata/symbology/account operations are free; time-series bytes are billable
databento_public_capability.historical_exchange_license_statement: Databento states historical T+1 data does not require a market-data license, subject to exceptions such as redistribution.

databento_account_probe.reason: The local Work runtime rejects direct outbound API calls under HR-002 and no authenticated Databento connector/plugin is mounted. Plugin discovery returned no Databento/market-data API connector.
not_verified: NG.FUT symbol resolution for this account
sample payload normalization against the live account

adapter_evidence.auth: HTTP Basic: DATABENTO_API_KEY username, blank password; key excluded from query/body/manifest

canonical_semantics.settle: statistics.price where stat_type=3, final flag set, and intraday-settlement flag clear
canonical_semantics.volume: statistics.quantity where stat_type=6; null/sentinel/negative values excluded
canonical_semantics.available_at: latest availability across populated settlement and cleared-volume statistics; ts_recv preferred, else ts_event

archive.curve_bound: expiration rank per trade date <= max_contracts

history_depth.massive: 2 years on current Basic; 5 years at Developer; NYMEX flat-file history publicly listed from 2017-04-03 on higher access
history_depth.databento: GLBX.MDP3 catalog coverage begins 2010-06-06, but exact account/schema range remains unverified

canonical_fields.massive: per-contract settlement, OHLCV, expiration available in existing adapter/snapshot
canonical_fields.databento: official CME settlement, cleared volume, open interest, definitions/expiration, OHLCV schemas publicly documented

cost.massive: Basic is $0/month for 2 years; deeper history requires paid plan
cost.databento: usage-based historical pricing with $125 new-account credit; exact NG request cost must be obtained from account metadata before download

licensing.massive: project-specific non-display backtesting rights remain unresolved
licensing.databento: Databento states T+1 historical data does not require an exchange license; redistribution exceptions remain and project-specific contractual use has not been separately signed off

operational_stability.massive: working account path already preserved locally and tested
operational_stability.databento: adapter tested against documented HTTP contract but live account cannot be exercised in current Work runtime

decision.reason: Databento is the stronger technical candidate on documented history depth and official CME statistics, but an account-specific metadata/cost probe and tiny live sample are still required before provider selection or serious training.
decision.next_gate: Run metadata-only Databento account probe through an approved authenticated connector or outside the Work outbound-network boundary, then permit only a cost-bounded tiny NG sample if the probe succeeds.
